svg.text: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input
Packing and context axis come from the run
Each block emits a residual update and a skip
Sum skip outputs; PReLU and 1x1 projection.
Configured mask activation for each source.
Multiply each source mask by the original encoded
Transposed convolution per source; crop to input length.
Source 0: clean EEG; source 1: gradient artifact for the
Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.
Deployment input normalisation → Noisy waveform · flow
Noisy waveform → Learned analysis filters · flow
Learned analysis filters → Normalise and project · flow
Normalise and project → Temporal convolution stack · flow
Temporal convolution stack → Source mask head · flow
Source mask head → Apply masks to encoding · flow
Apply masks to encoding → Shared synthesis decoder · flow
Shared synthesis decoder → Ordered sources · flow
Learned analysis filters → Apply masks to encoding · skip: Unmasked encoded features
Ordered sources → Deployment artifact output · flow
Deployment changes normalisation and objective; architecture parameters remain
